prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production game sprite, a modern sporty commuter scooter inspired by image 1 (angular graphite/olive grey fairings, black saddle, angular LED headlight, black alloy wheels, two mirrors). Image 1 is shape reference only. Image 2 is STRICT illustration style reference: hand-drawn French cartoon game, dark ink outlines, painted warm subtle texture, simplified readable forms. Same strict side profile facing RIGHT as image 2, both wheels on same horizontal baseline, no three-quarter view. Single empty scooter, whole vehicle entirely visible with generous transparent margin. No rider, no stand extended, no text, no logo, no ground, no cast shadow, no glow. Truly transparent background. This exact model will also be used for candidate riders.

Use case: identity-preserve. Production 2D game sprite sheet. Image 1 is STRICT character identity, costume and drawing style reference. Image 2 is exact new scooter model reference. Make FOUR poses of Jean-Luc Mélenchon riding ONLY the modern angular graphite/olive grey scooter from image 2, never the red retro scooter or bicycle. Single column, four separated rows, each whole rider and whole scooter visible, facing RIGHT in strict side profile, both wheels level. Order top to bottom: 1 black suit red scarf glasses grey hair, 2 same black suit red scarf plus French tricolor sash, 3 navy suit purple scarf, 4 blue worker suit red scarf. Preserve caricature face and oversized head proportions and thick ink painted cartoon style of image 1. Each row identical scooter geometry, size and wheel positions; hands on handlebars, feet on floorboard. Use wide transparent vertical gaps between rows, equal height cells. No text, no labels, no scenery, no glow or shadow. REAL TRANSPARENT background with alpha zero outside the silhouettes, including gaps. Portrait sheet.
